parameters.excerpt: If the address is not naturally aligned, an address-misaligned exception or an access-fault exception will be generated.
parameters.reasoning: The spec uses 'or' between two exception types for misaligned Zalasr accesses, which in RISC-V convention indicates an implementation choice. The implementer chooses which exception to raise (address-misaligned vs access-fault). This is a direct design-time choice not controlled by any CSR.
